column1: # TITLE: Expression data from platelets from early NSCLC and HNSCC patients in tumour presence and tumor free samples
# SUMMARY: Gene expression profile of platelets. In this study
column2: we try to address the knowledge gap regarding liquid biopsy markers for early detection of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC). For that blood samples were collected in two time points
column3: in the presence and absence of NSCLC or HNSCC. Platelets were isolated and gene expression evaluated by microarray technique.
